title: Final Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the average Poynting vector, \bar{\mathbf{S}}.

title: Final Power Distribution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct angular power distribution, d\bar{P}/d\Omega.

title: Final Average Power
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the total average power radiated, \overline{P}, accurately.

title: Field Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct application of the magnetic field equation and the use of the superposition principle.

title: Reasoning on Superposition
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain why the power seems to satisfy superposition despite being quadratic in nature.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check and confirm that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for the dipole radiation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the derivation of the fields.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any factors in the expressions for the fields or power calculations.
